## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else paste(Standard.target, "Design Criteria")`

```{r}
#| include: false
.STD <- tolower(Standard.target)
.STEM <- .STD
.SITE <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
if (is.character(.SITE) && length(.SITE) == 1L && nzchar(.SITE)) .STEM <- paste0(tolower(.SITE), "-", .STD)
.VARS <- list(
  Standard.target = Standard.target,
  ID.target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID.target = .SITE
)
.VARS <- .VARS[lengths(.VARS) > 0L]
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width}

### Criteria

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(path = paste0("/_tbl/", .STD, ".qmd"), stem = .STEM, labels = "rewrite", vars = .VARS, root = root)
```
